description:
As a customer, I want to search so I can find a tool quickly.

* A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
* A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
* Search is case-insensitive.
* Clearing the search restores the full product list.

Search matches product names (partial, case-insensitive)

criteria.text: A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
Clearing the search restores the full product list.

cases.title: Search term matching existing products lists only matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and shows a set of products, including at least one product whose name contains "hammer" and at least one product whose name does not.
steps: Note the full list of products currently displayed.
Enter the search term "hammer" in the search field.
cases.expected: Only products whose names match "hammer" are listed; products that do not match are not shown.

cases.title: Search term with no matches shows empty state message without error
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and no product name contains the string "zzzqqq".
steps: Enter the search term "zzzqqq" in the search field.
cases.expected: No products are listed and an empty state message is shown (exact text not specified in the story). No error is shown.

cases.title: Search in upper case returns the same matching products as lower case
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and at least one product name contains "hammer" (in its normal casing).
steps: Enter the search term "HAMMER" in the search field and apply the search.
Clear the search field, enter "hammer" and apply the search.
Compare the products listed with those noted in step 2.
cases.expected: Both searches list the same matching products; the search is case-insensitive.

cases.title: Search with mixed-case partial product name matches
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and at least one product exists whose name contains the fragment "ammer" (for example a product named "Hammer").
steps: Enter the partial, mixed-case term "aMMer" in the search field.
cases.expected: Products whose names contain that fragment are listed; matching is partial and case-insensitive.

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and shows the full product list containing several products, including at least one matching "hammer" and at least one not matching.
steps: Note the full list of products displayed.
Enter the search term "hammer" and apply the search so that the list is filtered.
cases.expected: The full product list as noted in step 1 is displayed again.

cases.title: Clearing the search after a no-match term restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and shows the full product list; no product name contains the string "zzzqqq".
steps: Note the full list of products displayed.
Enter the search term "zzzqqq" and apply the search.
cases.expected: After step 3 the empty state message is shown with no error (message text not specified in the story); after clearing, the full product list as noted in step 1 is displayed again.
